## Pre-registered signature effects (arm full)

1. Span rises well above 7 (block span >= 15): max 12.4 [11.8-12.8] -> **fails**.
2. Rate (decision): first session at 80 = [None, None, None] -> **fails (stall: 80 never reached)**.
3. 4-digit groups err more: no lists >= 30 with both sizes -> **not reached**.
4. Prior knowledge speeds early learning: s15 full 9.5 vs prioroff 7.9; s50 full 9.9 vs prioroff 8.0 -> **holds**.
5. Letter span about 7 (mean probe max <= 9): final 7.0 [7.0-7.0], max 8.0 [8.0-8.0] -> **holds**.
Redundancy: span at s250 full 7.7 vs no rescue 5.7 -> **holds**.
